item.title: OpenClaw is What Apple Intelligence Should Have Been
item.description: Something strange is happening with Mac Minis. They’re selling out everywhere, and it’s not because people suddenly need more coffee table computers. They’re setting up headless machines whose sole job is to automate their workflows.
